note: the belief that skincare has to tingle to work
s:
1. I discarded forty jars before stabilizing my cream.
2. In my experience, the batches I discarded taught me more than any good one, because my very first formulation separated overnight beside the stove.
3. Before I found a stable emulsion, I patch tested each version on my inner arm for three days, keeping a simple chart of redness.
4. Before placing any new product on your face, always patch test on your inner arm for three days. Keeping a simple record of any redness will reveal how your barrier responds before irritation reaches your cheeks.

s:
